correction: v0.2 omitted the v0.1 stable plan linkage when splitting baseline from fill. v0.2.1 requires planScanDate for every FILL and introduces ledgerEpochId for both baseline and fills.

requirements.ledgerEpochId: required for every event; isolates separate coverage epochs
requirements.planScanDate: required for FILL; optional for POSITION_BASELINE because pre-existing holdings may predate the monitored plan
requirements.signalEventId: optional link only; never execution identity

bootstrap: POSITION_BASELINE is non-trade opening evidence; zero-to-BUY can start without baseline; ADD/REDUCE/SELL require prior state in the same epoch
pit: effectiveAt and confirmedAt remain distinct; later correction affects as-known state only after confirmedAt
